input.content: Idempotency/recovery key mismatch (P0 pattern): In a recovery-record store keyed by operation_id (store.recovery[operation_id] = record), the save() lookup was changed to scan records by a NON-KEY field (workspace): next(r for r in store.recovery.values() if r["workspace"]==workspace). Effect: once any record exists for a workspace, later saves with a DIFFERENT operation_id/values match the stale record, hit the `status != "pending"` guard, skip store.apply(), and return {"ok": True} — silently dropping every operation after the first per workspace (data loss + false success). Smell signature: store written under key K but read by scanning .values() on a different field. Fix: look up by the same key used to write (store.recovery.get(operation_id)). Keep the legitimate recovery reorder (persist values before apply; pending-guard prevents double-apply on retry).
